name: Bhavay Aggarwal
landingLine: Developer turned *AI project manager*. My friends call me *Bunny*.
intro: I run hybrid Agile and Waterfall delivery for cross-functional teams, and I use Python, SQL and AI to turn KPI data into delivery decisions rather than just reporting on them.
summary: Project Lead with a track record of running hybrid Agile and Waterfall delivery for cross-functional teams under direct client management. I lead program delivery for a 95+ person team at Flixstock, owning end-to-end production planning and delivery for a $6.4 billion valuation client. I combine project management and budget oversight with technical fluency in Python, SQL and AI-augmented reporting.
